executive_summary: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. The current process works but is held together by manual handoffs across four systems. The returns order, receipt and credit legs map onto documented SAP standard steps; the inspection leg does not exist in the system of record at all, which is the principal gap and the main source of dealer disputes.
verdict_rationale: Three of six steps are manual handoffs, and inspection evidence sits outside the system of record. SAP standard documents an inspection step whose outcome drives the follow-up activity, and leading networks decide returnability before the part ships. The current design does neither.

gaps.title: Returnability is decided after the part has shipped
gaps.current_state: The dealer raises a request with free-text defect description; a clerk reviews it afterwards by email.
gaps.sap_standard_reference: SAP documents a returns order created with reference to the preceding sales document, which places the decision at order creation.
gaps.industry_reference: Leading networks make the returnability judgement in the workshop at the point of diagnosis, so invalid returns never enter the network.
gaps.gap_description: Transport and receipt costs are incurred on returns that are later rejected, and the dealer learns the outcome late.
gaps.recommendation: Gate the return request at creation with guided diagnosis and catalogue validation, so an authorisation is either granted or refused before the part is packed.

evidence.quote: Leaders decide returnability at the point of diagnosis, before the part leaves the dealership.

gaps.title: Inspection evidence lives outside the system of record
gaps.current_state: Outcomes and dispositions are recorded in a shared spreadsheet reconciled weekly.
gaps.sap_standard_reference: SAP documents an inspection at returns receipt whose result determines the follow-up activity for the returned material.
gaps.industry_reference: Inspection outcomes are captured against a controlled vocabulary of disposition codes rather than as narrative.
gaps.gap_description: Credits cannot be defended with evidence, reconciliation is weekly, and no root-cause analysis is possible.
gaps.recommendation: Move inspection into the standard returns inspection step with structured disposition codes, and attach photographic evidence to the returns document.

evidence.quote: The inspection result determines the follow-up activity for the returned material.

gaps.title: No status visibility between shipment and credit
gaps.current_state: Carrier tracking sits in the carrier portal; dealers phone the claims team for status.
gaps.sap_standard_reference: The retrieved SAP sources describe returns delivery and inbound receipt documents that carry status, but did not establish a dealer-facing application.
gaps.industry_reference: Status is shared with the dealer continuously from initiation through to settlement.
gaps.gap_description: Dealer chasing consumes claims-team capacity and damages the relationship.
gaps.recommendation: Expose returns document status to the dealer front-end; confirm with SAP whether a standard application covers this before designing an extension.

gaps.title: Custom ECC objects will not carry forward
gaps.current_state: ZRET_AUTH, ZRET_REPORT and a custom IDoc extension carry the process today.
gaps.sap_standard_reference: The documented standard flow covers returns order, delivery, receipt, inspection and credit memo.
gaps.gap_description: Each custom object duplicates something the standard flow already documents, and each one is a migration cost.
gaps.recommendation: Retire ZRET_AUTH and ZRET_REPORT against the standard flow and standard reporting; keep the IDoc extension only if the dealer front-end cannot be re-pointed.

to_be_process.name: Guided return request with returnability gate
to_be_process.description: The dealer is guided through diagnosis; the system validates the part and either authorises or refuses before packing.
to_be_process.change_vs_current: Decision moves ahead of transport; free-text is replaced by structured coding.

to_be_process.name: Returns order created automatically
to_be_process.description: An authorised request creates the returns order with reference to the preceding document, with no re-keying.

to_be_process.name: Inbound receipt against returns delivery
to_be_process.description: The distribution centre receives the part against the returns delivery.
to_be_process.change_vs_current: Receipt is matched automatically instead of by phone.

to_be_process.name: Inspection with structured disposition
to_be_process.description: The inspection result and disposition are recorded on the returns document with evidence attached.

to_be_process.name: Automatic credit or reasoned rejection
to_be_process.description: Disposition drives the credit memo or a coded rejection visible to the dealer.
to_be_process.change_vs_current: Removes weekly reconciliation and email notification.

quick_wins: Replace the free-text defect field with a defect code list in the existing portal
Publish return status to dealers from the existing documents before the wider redesign
roadmap_phases: Phase 1 - define the defect and disposition code catalogues with engineering and quality
Phase 2 - implement the standard returns flow with inspection in S/4HANA
Phase 3 - re-point the dealer front-end and retire the custom objects
risks: Defect code catalogue definition is a cross-functional dependency and is on the critical path
Dealer adoption of guided diagnosis needs training and incentives
assumptions: The retrieved SAP sources did not establish whether a standard dealer-facing application exists; G03 assumes an extension until SAP confirms otherwise
